book: A single Latin treatise by Franciscus Junius, De peccato primo Adami et genere causae qua ad peccandum adductus est (Leiden, Plantin, 1595), in four quaestiones: the first has five chapters, the second four, the third and fourth one each. It is preceded by a dedication to the Zeeland estates and an index, and followed by errata; the patristic quotations at the end are citations, not divisions.
